close_reason: Replace subsec_micros() with AtomicU64 counter to guarantee uniqueness under concurrent POSTs
description: Trigger: two POST requests arrive simultaneously (e.g. from a drain session batch) within the same microsecond on the same process. inject_message_id in post/injection.rs computes the message-id as PID.subsec_micros()@hostname. std::process::id() is constant for the process lifetime; subsec_micros() wraps every second. Two posts landing in the same microsecond produce identical Message-IDs. The second post hits the duplicate-msgid guard and is rejected with 435, silently dropping valid content.
title: inject_message_id PID+microsecond collision on concurrent posts
